nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Wastewater treatment|Microbial treatment technologies_qna_000
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: How do microbial fuel cells (MFCs) contribute to energy generation and wastewater treatment?
nodes.answer: MFCs generate electricity by consuming organic contaminants found in wastewater, thereby producing energy while also treating the water.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Wastewater treatment|Microbial treatment technologies_qna_001
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What is a possible solution to inefficiencies in energy generation discussed in the paragraph?
nodes.answer: The application of microbial fuel cells (MFCs) for wastewater treatment is suggested as a more affordable and ecologically friendly solution.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Wastewater treatment|Microbial treatment technologies_qna_002
nodes.label: Technology
nodes.question: What technology is highlighted in the review for its potential in cleaning wastewater and generating energy?
nodes.answer: Microbial fuel cells (MFCs) are highlighted for their potential to cleanse wastewater and recover energy.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Wastewater treatment|Microbial treatment technologies_qna_003
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What do microbial fuel cells (MFCs) address in relation to energy and environmental issues?
nodes.answer: MFCs address both wastewater treatment and energy production, providing a long-term solution to energy and environmental issues.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Wastewater treatment|Microbial treatment technologies_qna_004
nodes.label: Science and Tech
nodes.question: How does Zenith et al. (2016) propose to treat industrial wastewater, and what is the significance of using microbes for this purpose?
nodes.answer: Zenith et al. (2016) propose the use of microbes as eco-friendly tools for the treatment of industrial wastewater. Microbes are significant as they offer an environmentally friendly solution for managing industrial waste waters.
